stops.note: combined nextli 'ashes/lime' and tamalli 'dough', describing corn soaked in lime water
adopted into Mexican Spanish for the traditional corn-processing method
stops.meaning: corn kernels treated with lime and ready for grinding

stops.note: adopted into English food science to describe the ancient corn-processing technique
stops.meaning: the process of soaking corn in an alkaline solution before grinding

current_meaning: the traditional process of soaking and cooking maize in an alkaline solution to make it more nutritious and easier to grind
